text:
alexa: heads up: nightly SAST failed with a KMS decrypt permission denied. CI log: `PermissionDenied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt`
mike: did we roll any IAM cleanup yesterday?
alexa: yep, infra tidy removed some broad bindings. scanner SA lost decrypt on the app key.
sam: I tried to fetch audit logs for the decrypt call but nothing shows up for the SA time window. ran: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --project=redwood-prod` -> empty
audit-bot: automated note: IAM change applied by @mike at 2024-09-18T02:14Z (removed role bindings: infra-service-accounts)
security-oncall: two possible causes: call never reached KMS due to IAM rejection, or audit logging for KMS is not enabled/was filtered out. compliance will want audit traces.
mike: temp plan: I'll grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to the cryptoKey for scanner SA and make it short-lived.
alexa: CI reran after temp grant and SAST passed. please file an incident+owners.
sam: owner list: mike (RBAC PR), alexa (incident + runbook updates), sam (audit sink & retention). I'll look at sink filters and retention settings; if KMS methods were excluded we need to enable and backfill if possible.
security-oncall: add follow-up to consider per-env CMEK and key access approvals. also update PR checklist to require scoped key bindings when creating service accounts that need secrets.
mike: creating PR now with a scoped binding and a 24h TTL. will request reviews from @security-oncall and @cloud-infra.
alexa: thanks — documenting in the ticket and pinging release-war-room if deploy impacted.
